profile.headline: Executive Advisor at Vanthro Group
profile.summary:
I am a technology executive and strategic leader with more than 30 years of international experience driving growth at the high-stakes intersection of global business leadership and technical architecture. My career has been defined by guiding organizations—from lean start-ups to Fortune 100 enterprises—through periods of radical industrial shift by aligning strategic planning with operational excellence.

I am deeply passionate about building and executing high-impact go-to-market strategies and improving operational efficiencies through the implementation of robust systems. Throughout my tenure at industry leaders such as Huawei, Amdocs, and Amax Engineering, I have specialized in the "concept-to-market" and "lead-to-cash" lifecycles. I have a proven track record of building global Centers of Excellence and executing digital transformation programs that drive multi-million dollar revenue growth.

My core expertise is anchored in three strategic pillars:

GTM Strategy & Global Infrastructure: I have directed product management and marketing for complex ecosystems, including High-Performance Computing (HPC), AI computing, and cloud infrastructure. My work includes driving global industry standards, such as my service as an Executive Committee Board Member at the TM Forum, where I championed the development of global business process frameworks.


Systems-Driven Operational Excellence: I specialize in optimizing talent, knowledge, and customer acquisition systems to improve organizational productivity. At Huawei, I led the transformation of integrated product development processes, achieving over $100M in go-to-market cost efficiencies. My experience also includes commanding post-merger integration committees to accelerate product synergies and systemic alignment.

The Future of Learning & AI: Currently, as the founder of Learnbotix, I am dedicated to advancing human potential through intelligent learning systems. By researching and designing AI-powered platforms, I aim to move beyond rote instruction to cultivate the critical thinking and cognitive agility required to thrive in an increasingly automated economy.

I am focused on building enduring organizational capability by connecting elite talent with large-scale operational deployment. Whether navigating complex M&A, driving global industry standards, or pioneering next-generation education technology, I remain dedicated to delivering high-value solutions that result in a sustainable competitive advantage

positions.title: Executive Advisor
positions.description: In my role at Vantrho Group, I specialize in aligning organizational leadership and talent with strategic business goals. I focus on developing high-impact talent and preparing organizations for workforce transformations driven by AI and evolving skill needs. My work encompasses consulting, coaching, and executive search, ensuring that organizations build the necessary capabilities for effective growth and execution.
positions.insights: Skills: Strategising · Executive Coaching · Strategic Initiatives · Knowledge Management

positions.title: Executive Director / Owner
positions.description:
Visionary educational and business leader responsible for the full-cycle management of K–12 learning operations.

Drove 400% increase in center profitability within two years through disciplined P&L management, sales process optimization, and operational efficiency.

Consistently exceeded monthly sales and enrollment targets by 20%+ through needs-based consultation and value-driven enrollment strategy.

Oversaw all operations, marketing, personnel, and academic delivery, ensuring alignment between business goals and student outcomes.

Enhanced academic quality control and staff training, improving instructional results and parent satisfaction.

Built strategic partnerships with schools, educators, and local businesses, establishing the center as a trusted community learning resource.

Explored AI integration to improve learning outcomes and adaptive instruction through data-driven methodologies.

Providing every child the best education possible.
Open to collaborations, ed-tech dev and programs that drive learning effectiveness from primary education to professional development
Research and study of learning effectiveness and the application of AI
positions.insights: Skills: Sales Management · Team Leadership · Conversion Marketing · Requirements Analysis · Educational Technology · Operations Management · P&L Management · Research · Educational Leadership

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description:
•Lead strategic planning and execution, and fundraising to turnaround optical archival storage company. 
•Drive partner and industry growth initiatives to propel demand for long-term data storage applications and systems.
•Established new company and brand, board of advisors, and supply chains
•Research and study the future of intelligent document and digital asset management
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Change Management · Innovation Management · Product Lifecycle Management · Product Strategy · Public Relations · Sales Enablement · International Business Development

positions.title: Sr VP. Marketing and Corporate Strategy
positions.description:
•Led business transformation through strategic planning of 3 business units on path to IPO.
•Optimized marketing, product management, sales enablement and training, and partner business management teams increasing 25% productivity and efficiency across sales, supply chain, and engineering. 
•Accelerated inbound and outbound sales cycles by 200% by optimizing and implementing customer acquisition, CPQ, order and knowledge systems which elevated conversion rate by more than 30%.
•Re-vamped market, product, and services strategy for OEM contract manufacturing/supply chain services, HPC, enterprise storage, AI computing, data center rack integration, liquid cooling, and Nvidia partner business resulting 50% in new account growth.  
•Developed NPI programs to support and secure the acquisition of multimillion dollar OEM accounts
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Manufacturing Operations Management · Change Management · Conversion Marketing · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Innovation Management · Product Lifecycle Management · Product Strategy · Contract Manufacturing · Public Relations · Sales Enablement

positions.title: VP, IT Product line, Cloud and AI, Telecoms Business Sector
positions.description:
•Governed strategic product roadmap, positioning, competitive intelligence, and innovation cycle
•Co-chair the product management and development team review and decision point meetings.
•Spearhead and align business unit activities to grow Openstack IaaS cloud deployments and investments.

positions.title: VP, Carrier Software Business Unit, Carrier BG Marketing
positions.description:
•Grew Huawei BSS as top 3 global leaders in Business Support Systems, at 19% CAGR in 4 years.
•Oversaw Chief Engineer Office and managed team of 250+ employees in 3 countries, leading growth across product and solution marketing, business consulting, planning, and operations from concept to market.
•Led the transformation of Huawei’s Integrated Product Development processes into a market-oriented organization achieving product development efficiencies and GTM costs by $100M. 
•Led the planning of hundreds of campaigns including major launches including Huawei BES (billing, CRM and Order software) and IPTV V6, integrated video cloud platform achieving $3M in earned media value. 
•Masterminded and curated Global IT Executive Advisory Board and Voice of Customer programs that was joined by over 20 C-level members at top tier telecom companies. 
•Fueled BSS revenue growth outside of China to achieve 19% CAGR in five years.
•Grew and exceeded the unit’s annual business targets and KPIs to over $1.2 billion in 3 years

positions.title: VP, Head of Global Business Consulting
positions.description:
•Recruited, built, and developed IT enterprise architecture framework that consisted of 5 key consulting practices. Planned, organized, and directed over 100 consultants worldwide in digital transformation projects resulting in key account breakthroughs and wins – including company’s first full-scale $100M IT outsourcing project in Europe and Africa. 
•Appointed to sponsor and facilitate T1 client engagements and de-escalations of high-priority company-level projects from lead-to-cash thorough issue to resolution phases. 
•Spearheaded and planned change management projects in human resources, policies, operations, and communications that enabled the cultural integration of non-Chinese employees into an inclusive and diverse work environment across U.S. China, Germany, India.
•Improved conversion metrics and win rates of front-line teams by 200%

positions.title: Sr. Director, BSS/OSS Marketing and Product Management, Software Product Line
positions.description:
•Led re-architect initiative and effort of core BSS/OSS online platform (BES) and its go-to-market strategy which focused on reducing deployment time and costs by as much as 50%
•Championed customer requirements, and secured company funding to diversify the company’s CRM offering from a single product to 3.  
•Recruited as a Sr. Partner, Global Consulting Center to build the company’s competencies in telecoms operations software, consulting, professional services, and drive customer influence.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Telecom BSS · Change Management · Business Support System (BSS) · Product Strategy · Sales Enablement · Copywriting

positions.title: Director, Regional Marketing and Business Development
positions.description:
•Handpicked by HQ as member of on-the-ground leadership team to command post merger integration committee of China-based company to accelerate product synergies and align the cultures to drive growth.
•Defused PR crisis into positive outcomes as HQ spokesperson and government relations delegate.  
•Orchestrated account plans and strategies across sales, product management teams, and 3rd party system integrators to drive product adoption of Telecom business operations software, infrastructure, and services.
•Drove over $20M in expansion revenue by pioneering customer experience systems, solutions and programs that influenced the direction of Chinese telecom operators and executives.

positions.title: Portfolio Product Marketing Manager - Product Business Group
positions.description:
•Responsible for external implementation of the Product Business Group marketing plan.
•Masterminded plans and portfolio product strategy into effective marketing practices that generated sales opportunities and buy-in at the world’s largest telecom operator groups.
•Championed unique thought leadership, industry insight, key messages and differentiated value propositions that improved portfolio’s competitive market position and increased CSAT scores.
•Execute market strategies and tactics with international ecosystem of alliance partners. Teamed with IBM to launch telecom order-to-cash solution which won business with SFR and Telstra.

positions.title: Alliances Marketing Manager
positions.description:
•Steered global strategic alliance program for ISVs and systems integrators including marketing campaigns, portfolio roadmaps, and partner relationships. 
•Teamed with IBM to launch telecom order-to-cash solution which won business with SFR and Telstra.

positions.title: Sr Manager, Corporate Marketing
positions.description:
•Negotiated contracts and managed $1.2M budget in integrated marketing campaigns, websites, advertising, brand identity, public media relations, sales tools, events, and executive programs. 
•Positioned XACCT as a category-defining leading company through media, industry analysts, investment community, and telecom market segments.
•Developed launched successful ecosystem alliance program as the core business development platform
